args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 3.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `3.1.0` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson==2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). The advisory fixes this in `2.9.4` and `3.1.0`. Since the team completed the fastjson 3.x migration last sprint, this PR takes the 3.x fix (`3.1.0`).

## Testing

CI passed on the branch (`ci-0001`).
